assets.title: The missing villagers' map
assets.alt: A torn, soot-stained pencil map of mine tunnels. At the top, double doors in a ring of rune marks, labelled DOORS; a cart track runs down the middle. Left: a small room labelled supply room, and blue crystals labelled blue rock hums??. Right: an upper passage ending at a T-shaped timber frame, and a lower one past a zigzag and fallen rocks labelled DANGER!, ending at another. At the bottom, a second rune-ringed door where the paper is torn; the note beside it has worn away.
assets.showWhen: Lost Mine of Whisperhollow only: when the party finds the missing villagers' supplies inside the mine doors, and again whenever a player asks to see that map. Never before it is found.

assets.title: Corwin's bronze medallion
assets.alt: A palm-sized bronze medallion, green-black with age and crusted with barnacles, lying on wet deck boards among strands of net. Curling waves fill its upper half, some trailing down like tendrils; in the centre a human-like figure, seen from behind, curls and bows, wrapped in loops of chain. A ring of worn, unreadable glyphs runs around the rim, and a loop at the top once held a cord.
assets.showWhen: Sunken Temple of Tidecaller only: when Corwin holds out the medallion, and again whenever a player asks to see it or compares it with the temple's mosaic or empty token slots.
